Preserve C021-M03's point with A021G07's additional pale lower path, as one qualified point/trace cluster; B/C draw the point alone, A includes the lower trace. C1/H1, low for that complete cluster; hand, role, attachment to roof and surface origin remain undetermined. No additional alpha, point or union crossing is to be duplicated by the merged source.

## 14 — Complete marginal diagram, both braces and all six Sigma labels

Viewed `readers/021/A/c09_margin_diagram.png` once.

Select A021DG as the complete anchored tikz-cd parent, with both literal looped braces, five upright rows, the two sideways signed Sigma labels and all visible endpoints. The top upright row is Sigma_i^+ ou Sigma_i^-; the next rows E_i, qualified Sigma_{i alpha}, E_alpha, Sigma_{alpha0}^+. The sideways labels have the complete shared terminal hook/dot i forms, with minus and plus respectively, and must remain literal as A draws them. For the third upright row replace A021D03's glyph source with B021-G06's complete nested third-label group (shared lower-arm hook and dot once), retaining the complete candidate set Sigma_{i alpha} | Sigma_{i,alpha} | Sigma_{dot alpha}; actual C021-R08 retained, medium, C0/H0 component under the H parent. No independent extra i body or comma is supplied. Actual C021-R07 resolves to a literal upright shaft-and-point ! shape, medium, C1/H0 component: in this rotated crop it is one detached point followed by one bent short run; no pair of ou loops is present. Remove the unsure wrapper around A021D05 but keep its literal point/run, and do not assign the sign a mathematical function. The four upright Sigma upper-run roles (top pair, third row, bottom row) remain head/retrace | independent upper rule, low, each C1/H0; later recurring role wrappers are not printed again. The small pale detached run beyond the outer brace is visible: retain qualified A021M04, C1/H0, low, role/hand/surface origin undetermined. The complete brace/placement restoration is one C1/H1 medium parent; the single H diagram-note replacement includes its omitted components, so every diagram component has zero additional H count. The separately inspected lead-in from section13 is outside this parent. B/C's ordinary font sideways Sigmas and B's ordinary upright top/bottom font spans remain quoted alternatives in the source record.

## 16 — Exclusion formula and short interrupted right head

Viewed `readers/021/A/c11_exclusion.png` once.

Select A's complete exclusion sequence A021G10 + A021G11 + A021G12 in place of C021-G06. A021G12 retains those pale pieces that C's continuous head path omits. The two local Sigma head/retrace-versus-independent-rule roles remain qualified in the record, low, each C1/H0; preserve complete glyph clusters without another printed recurring wrapper. The literal crossed-inclusion drawing preserves the shared not-subset reading and its two actual strokes; this alone is C0/H0, a same-reading graphic realization rather than an additional correction count. No extra horizontal equality stroke is supplied.

## 14 — Complete marginal diagram, both braces and all six Sigma labels

Viewed `readers/021/A/c09_margin_diagram.png` once.

Select A021DG as the complete anchored tikz-cd parent, with both literal looped braces, five upright rows, the two sideways signed Sigma labels and all visible endpoints. The top upright row is Sigma_i^+ ou Sigma_i^-; the next rows E_i, qualified Sigma_{i alpha}, E_alpha, Sigma_{alpha0}^+. The sideways labels have the complete shared terminal hook/dot i forms, with minus and plus respectively, and must remain literal as A draws them. For the third upright row replace A021D03's glyph source with B021-G06's complete nested third-label group (shared lower-arm hook and dot once), retaining the complete candidate set Sigma_{i alpha} | Sigma_{i,alpha} | Sigma_{dot alpha}; actual C021-R08 retained, medium, C0/H0 component under the H parent. No independent extra i body or comma is supplied. Actual C021-R07 resolves to a literal upright shaft-and-point ! shape, medium, C1/H0 component: in this rotated crop it is one detached point followed by one bent short run; no pair of ou loops is present. Remove the unsure wrapper around A021D05 but keep its literal point/run, and do not assign the sign a mathematical function. The four upright Sigma upper-run roles (top pair, third row, bottom row) remain head/retrace | independent upper rule, low, each C1/H0; later recurring role wrappers are not printed again. The small pale detached run beyond the outer brace is visible: retain qualified A021M04, C1/H0, low, role/hand/surface origin undetermined. The complete brace/placement restoration is one C1/H1 medium parent; the single H diagram-note replacement includes its omitted components, so every diagram component has zero additional H count. The separately inspected lead-in from section13 is outside this parent. B/C's ordinary font sideways Sigmas and B's ordinary upright top/bottom font spans remain quoted alternatives in the source record.

## 25 — Source-only consolidation and attributed notes

No image reopened. S row SA01-K81-06 is a broad scans015-022 proposal whose author recorded no scan viewed; all three complete returns report no match for its quoted examples on scan021. Root confirms only the observed existing six roofs and bottom bar V, already in C and H; retain S_id and S_status="no quoted example matched; existing marks retained", C0/H0, with root_source_audit_choice_applied rather than inventing a new S ink correction. The independent local Sigma head-role doubts above remain recorded; S supplies no added bar.

The public notes attribute the page: alpha0 in K1 is followed by the written empty intersections and the expression U=X setminus the union of roofed Sigma_alpha^+ with K=K1 union {i}; the proof ends in the displayed intersection and cqfd. The underlined Corollaire du lemme calls the written expression for V unique and supplies the K condition using bar V and dot V. Its final complement is X setminus Sigma_alpha. Record the cancelled Sigma group, impli/impl., the recovered V beneath E, and the unresolved retracing after Or. No mathematical proof or inference was checked; reader check_events are empty. No written date or author page number is reported; archive 20 stays a source comment. Preserve actual abbreviations i.e, i.e., cqfd., comp. with probable expansions only in the abbreviation table; j:e. remains an unresolved literal lead-in rather than a silently normalized abbreviation.

Original C outcomes: resolved R02,R03,R07,R11,R13,R14 (6 rows/6 parts); retained R01,R04,R05,R06,R08,R09,R10,R12,R15 (9 rows/9 parts). Canonical part IDs end in -1. Count physical choices according to sections01-24, not raw reader aggregates. Every counted C/H difference and every remaining doubt has its actual A/B/C source readings, including report-silent source. The agreed ordinary prose, heading/underline spans, formulas and archive comment stay anchored to the three full independent half-page readings.

root_decision_sources.excerpt:
## 21 — Corollary prose accents, unique and dash

Viewed `readers/021/A/c15_precedent_line.png` once.

Select du lemme pr\unsure{ê|é|e}c\unsure{é|è|e}dent est \uline{unique} -- on a. The first high accent has a small rising left stroke and bent return; ê is the locally preferred shape, with é and absence retained because the tiny bend remains weak. A/B/C all prefer é, with ê alternatives; A also allows absence. This is one changed/new-qualified C/H locus, C1/H1, low. The second high stroke is a short near-upright tick, acute primary with grave/absent alternatives retained: A é|e, B é|è, C firm é. This second new firm-C qualification is C1/H0, low. Do not restore conventional spelling from the sentence. unique has one underline across its word span; the following dash is a separate horizontal run. H's emphasis conversion alone and the shared dash/on a wording receive C0/H0. Preserve their lower-block placement without duplicating a line of prose.

## 22 — Complete bottom conditions, overlapping V/E and physical page edge

Viewed `readers/021/C/crop13_bottom_brace.png` once.

The bottom set reads K={alpha in I | bar V cap E_alpha != empty, i.e. deleted V/live E_alpha cap dot V != empty}; retain its actual i.e. spacing with no newly added comma in the TeX. The first V has a separate flat bar and the later V a separate point, both already in C/H. Actual C021-R13 resolves as old V beneath live E_alpha, high, C1/H1: two thin obliques survive under the live E's vertical and horizontal strokes. Keep C021-G09b's complete overlap once, no extra generic strike. Preserve C021-G09's bottom formula and words, but replace its generic opening and closing set braces with B021-G10's full literal looped opening set brace and complete right closing curve; retain the main outer brace through the physical lower page edge without an invented lower return. Use one complete bottom-brace-geometry parent C1/H1, medium for outer plus set-brace paths, zero additional counts on its components. The bottom first Sigma_alpha^+ and final Sigma_alpha in X setminus Sigma_alpha have short upper runs and bent bodies; retain C021-G09's complete literal groups. Their head/retrace-versus-independent-rule doubts remain low, each C1/H0. The final complement's Sigma identity is clear against H's E_alpha: one separate identity row C0/H1, high, with the head-role child adding no further H count. Thus the second condition stays 'Sigma_alpha^+ est l'unique comp. de X setminus Sigma_alpha contenue dans X setminus V', with no final point supplied. The bottom edge cuts the lower continuation of the outer brace and some descenders; no unseen continuations are drawn.

The live K identity is retained, its extra-run/state role remains open (C1/H0 as new firm-C qualification). Actual C021-R04 remains retained as deleted qualified Sigma_alpha, low: the angular body and low curl survive, but cancellation strokes obscure the lower group's exact identity. Select B021-G02's complete nested cancelled group, including the zigzag crossing runs and low curl, inside the C021-G02 parent; no additional generic strike. This whole cancelled physical group has C1/H1, low for the added literal cancellation geometry and H's struck ill-placeholder, with the actual retained-doubt subrow C0/H0 so the group is counted once. C's firm resolution is not adopted. The K=K1 union {i} wording and its dot/index stay literal. C021-G02 will own the complete upper display; its main roofed Sigma and pale traces are separately pending local inspection.

## 14 — Complete marginal diagram, both braces and all six Sigma labels

Viewed `readers/021/A/c09_margin_diagram.png` once.

Select A021DG as the complete anchored tikz-cd parent, with both literal looped braces, five upright rows, the two sideways signed Sigma labels and all visible endpoints. The top upright row is Sigma_i^+ ou Sigma_i^-; the next rows E_i, qualified Sigma_{i alpha}, E_alpha, Sigma_{alpha0}^+. The sideways labels have the complete shared terminal hook/dot i forms, with minus and plus respectively, and must remain literal as A draws them. For the third upright row replace A021D03's glyph source with B021-G06's complete nested third-label group (shared lower-arm hook and dot once), retaining the complete candidate set Sigma_{i alpha} | Sigma_{i,alpha} | Sigma_{dot alpha}; actual C021-R08 retained, medium, C0/H0 component under the H parent. No independent extra i body or comma is supplied. Actual C021-R07 resolves to a literal upright shaft-and-point ! shape, medium, C1/H0 component: in this rotated crop it is one detached point followed by one bent short run; no pair of ou loops is present. Remove the unsure wrapper around A021D05 but keep its literal point/run, and do not assign the sign a mathematical function. The four upright Sigma upper-run roles (top pair, third row, bottom row) remain head/retrace | independent upper rule, low, each C1/H0; later recurring role wrappers are not printed again. The small pale detached run beyond the outer brace is visible: retain qualified A021M04, C1/H0, low, role/hand/surface origin undetermined. The complete brace/placement restoration is one C1/H1 medium parent; the single H diagram-note replacement includes its omitted components, so every diagram component has zero additional H count. The separately inspected lead-in from section13 is outside this parent. B/C's ordinary font sideways Sigmas and B's ordinary upright top/bottom font spans remain quoted alternatives in the source record.

## 14 — Complete marginal diagram, both braces and all six Sigma labels

Viewed `readers/021/A/c09_margin_diagram.png` once.

Select A021DG as the complete anchored tikz-cd parent, with both literal looped braces, five upright rows, the two sideways signed Sigma labels and all visible endpoints. The top upright row is Sigma_i^+ ou Sigma_i^-; the next rows E_i, qualified Sigma_{i alpha}, E_alpha, Sigma_{alpha0}^+. The sideways labels have the complete shared terminal hook/dot i forms, with minus and plus respectively, and must remain literal as A draws them. For the third upright row replace A021D03's glyph source with B021-G06's complete nested third-label group (shared lower-arm hook and dot once), retaining the complete candidate set Sigma_{i alpha} | Sigma_{i,alpha} | Sigma_{dot alpha}; actual C021-R08 retained, medium, C0/H0 component under the H parent. No independent extra i body or comma is supplied. Actual C021-R07 resolves to a literal upright shaft-and-point ! shape, medium, C1/H0 component: in this rotated crop it is one detached point followed by one bent short run; no pair of ou loops is present. Remove the unsure wrapper around A021D05 but keep its literal point/run, and do not assign the sign a mathematical function. The four upright Sigma upper-run roles (top pair, third row, bottom row) remain head/retrace | independent upper rule, low, each C1/H0; later recurring role wrappers are not printed again. The small pale detached run beyond the outer brace is visible: retain qualified A021M04, C1/H0, low, role/hand/surface origin undetermined. The complete brace/placement restoration is one C1/H1 medium parent; the single H diagram-note replacement includes its omitted components, so every diagram component has zero additional H count. The separately inspected lead-in from section13 is outside this parent. B/C's ordinary font sideways Sigmas and B's ordinary upright top/bottom font spans remain quoted alternatives in the source record.

## 17 — Cancelled verb and live replacement

Viewed `readers/021/A/c12_cancel_live_verb.png` once.

Actual C021-R10 retained as deleted impli | deleted impl., low. The initial point, surviving tall narrow loop, small high stroke and the long upper and shorter lower transverse runs are visible; the ending under those runs remains incomplete. Select complete literal B021-G08, preserving both drawn transverse runs and its surviving letter-body paths once, with no added generic strike and no expanded implique. A keeps the lower run within its letter-body drawing, B/C list two crossing runs; the final source keeps both observed traces without inferring their chronology. This physical cancelled cluster has one C1/H1 low count for the more explicit cancellation geometry and H's expanded word; the retained C doubt component is C0/H0. Actual C021-R11 resolves to live signifie, high, C1/H0: its dot, short i stroke and separate final narrow e stroke are visible. A/B/C agree on that live resolution. Keep the two original C identities separate.

## 19 — Corollary Pi group and detached trace above V

Viewed `readers/021/A/c13_pi_ring.png` once.

Actual C021-R12 remains retained as Pi_I^{circle|0}, medium, C0/H1 because H prints 0 and the selected primary remains circle. The small raised loop does not settle that typographic role. Select A021G22's complete literal Pi group: pale broken head, two stems including the interrupted right one, lower capital I and raised ring; B/C use an ordinary Pi font. This shape realization alone receives no additional C/H count. Preserve the independent small pale upright trace above the first V as qualified C021-M05, C1/H1, low; all three retain a point/short stroke there. Its role, hand, attachment and surface origin remain undetermined, and it does not become a dot decoration on V. The chosen lower-block parent must own V de, Pi and the comma exactly once; its remaining content is pending the later crops.

Its final line writes $X\setminus\Sigma_\alpha$.

| 21 | E_i inclusion and margin | ordinary U below a leading diagonal, X with difference slash; five upright rows with transverse sigma labels | `U_{J,i}`, `\setminus`; sideways `\Sigma_i^-`, `\Sigma_i^+` |
| 21 | corollary | two-stem Π topped by a small right-hand ring | `\Pi_I^\circ`, also `0` |

Viewed `readers/021/A/c09_margin_diagram.png` once.

Select A021DG as the complete anchored tikz-cd parent, with both literal looped braces, five upright rows, the two sideways signed Sigma labels and all visible endpoints. The top upright row is Sigma_i^+ ou Sigma_i^-; the next rows E_i, qualified Sigma_{i alpha}, E_alpha, Sigma_{alpha0}^+. The sideways labels have the complete shared terminal hook/dot i forms, with minus and plus respectively, and must remain literal as A draws them. No independent extra i body or comma is supplied. Actual C021-R07 resolves to a literal upright shaft-and-point ! shape, medium, C1/H0 component: in this rotated crop it is one detached point followed by one bent short run; no pair of ou loops is present.
